youtube.title: What is the fastest animal in the world? Not the cheetah 🏎️
youtube.description:
Cheetah, sailfish or the third one? One animal has been clocked at more than three times motorway speed, and the record was set over the United States with a skydiver alongside.
Guess before the reveal, then see the speeds side by side and where the record was measured.
Which one did you pick?
